body: Gameplay evidence for exact head 861a04010f2819493d5c37d0adf542eea9b78988, BYOND 516.1681, Nomads (Temperate), 155 x 225 x 2. This is the real full-game client in the isolated opt-in scene; the versioned loopback adapter invokes actual coal fueling, furnace/engine controls, cable placement/wirecutting, lamp callbacks and deletion. The match remains in pregame; this validates these running game object procedures and rendering, not a completed multiplayer round. Observed: two lamps draw 4 while root/remote capacity stays 15; cutting the middle cable leaves root 15 and remote 0, with both lamps off after callbacks settle; replacing it restores 15/4; removing one lamp reduces demand to 2; switching the engine off leaves capacity and settled demand at 0. Screenshots 01-05 show those five states. The MP4 records 25 genuine native window frames over about 42 seconds with original capture timing preserved; it is a low-frame-rate live sequence, with no synthetic/interpolated game imagery. Source, consumer callbacks and furnace fuel were allowed to run normally. https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7fee86f7-834c-44cd-a974-c6b269935c6d
